title: Three Family Members Killed in Shooting in North Carolina Neighborhood
text:
A shooting in a secluded North Carolina neighborhood has left three members of the same family dead and another injured. The incident is being investigated as a domestic case involving family members.
Three members of the same family were killed and another was rushed to the hospital after a shooting rocked a secluded North Carolina neighborhood, police said.
Shots rang out just before 8am on Wednesday at a home in Prospect Hill, a quaint community located in Caswell County that is about 45 miles outside of Greensboro. Cops found four adults suffering from gunshot wounds outside a home on Brooks Road. Three of them were pronounced dead at the scene, and the fourth was taken to Duke University Hospital, the North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation (NCSBI) said. The names of the deceased victims are unknown.
The suspected shooter was killed in the shooting, Caswell Sheriff Tony Durden said. The status and identity of the surviving victim is unclear. Police said there is no threat to the small community at this time and that it is believed to be an isolated incident. All three agencies have since gathered outside of the home as they continue to investigate the case, which has been described as a domestic case involving family members.
Shots rang out around 8.30am on Wednesday at a home in Prospect Hill, a quaint community located in Caswell County that is about 45 miles outside of Greensboro. No victims have been identified and there is no information on a possible suspect. It is unclear if the people involved in the deadly shooting knew each other Durden said the NCSBI has been processing evidence at the scene and conducting interviews.
His agency is working on notifying the victim's next of kin, Durden said. The incident remains under investigation
